title: Modern Healthcare: How Labcorp and Health Systems Are Meeting Patients Where They Are
summary: A recent article in Modern Healthcare examines how leading laboratory companies are helping health systems respond to financial pressures while meeting growing demand for more convenient, consumer-focused care.
body_markdown:
A recent article in[Modern Healthcare](https://www.modernhealthcare.com/providers/mh-quest-diagnostics-labcorp-health-systems/) examines how leading laboratory companies are helping health systems respond to financial pressures while meeting growing demand for more convenient, consumer-focused care. The article highlights Labcorp’s continued investments in strategic partnerships, expanded diagnostic capabilities and innovative service models that support health systems, researchers and patients.


The story also features insights from **Bryan Vaughn, executive vice president and president of diagnostics at Labcorp** , who notes that healthcare leaders are increasingly focused on delivering more consumer-friendly experiences. Vaughn explains that health systems are exploring new ways to connect with patients beyond traditional care settings, including virtual care and hospital-at-home programs. As those models evolve, Labcorp is focused on helping enable them by providing diagnostic services that meet patients where they are.


**Read the full article on**[Modern Healthcare](https://www.modernhealthcare.com/providers/mh-quest-diagnostics-labcorp-health-systems/) **to learn more about how Labcorp is helping health systems adapt to changing healthcare needs and expectations.**
